title: Policies
paragraphs: The system is intended for educational and recreational purposes. Users are expected to use the game responsibly and follow its intended functionality. All questions, challenges, and learning materials are designed to support knowledge development in Mathematics, Science, and Programming.

The project does not collect or require personal information, social media accounts, or online registration to access its features. Since the game operates offline, users are responsible for maintaining their own devices and ensuring that the system is used appropriately. Unauthorized modification, distribution, or misuse of the application is discouraged.
